summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute obfuscated payload under a vendor-scoped name
details: The package declares a `preinstall` hook that runs `node setup.mjs`, which downloads the Bun runtime from `github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/...` into a temporary directory, sets it executable, and then invokes it as `execFileSync(bun, ['math_init.js'])`. `math_init.js` is a ~727KB single-line obfuscated Bun-compiled bundle (`// @bun @bun-cjs` header, rotated string-array with a `WV8StW`-style rotator, hex-named identifiers) shipped at the tarball root and not referenced from any file in `src/` or `dist/`. The payload has no connection to the advertised micro-frontend purpose, and executing it under a separately downloaded runtime bypasses Node-based install-time inspection. The package publishes under the real vendor scope `@servicetitan/*` while pointing `repository` at `github.com/servicetitan/playground` (directory `MicroFrontEnd`), consistent with impersonation of the ServiceTitan brand. Installing the package causes arbitrary attacker-controlled code to execute on the installer's host at `npm install` time.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
